summary.name: Reclaim
summary.one_liner: Reclaim is an AI calendar app that automatically schedules tasks, habits, meetings and breaks for individuals and teams, working with Google Calendar and Outlook Calendar.
use_cases: Protecting focus time on a calendar
Tracking time use and fragmentation across a team
Scheduling breaks and lunch into the workday
summary.what_it_does: Reclaim uses AI to schedule focus time, tasks, habits, meetings and breaks directly into a calendar, and adapts the calendar when priorities change. For teams, it offers shared focus-time policies, meeting optimization and interruption reduction. It includes time intelligence features such as personal time tracking, a Deep Work Index, meeting load and fragmentation measurement, and team analytics dashboards. The page says it integrates with Google Calendar and Outlook Calendar and lists SOC 2 Type II, SSO/SCIM, and GDPR compliance among its security features.
notable: Team analytics and shared focus-time policies
Deep Work Index and focus time goals
SOC 2 Type II, SSO and SCIM provisioning
Live human support with stated under 20 minute average response
caveats: Page marks the app as free on Google Calendar and Outlook Calendar, but team and enterprise features (SSO, SCIM, custom onboarding) are presented as business offerings; exact paid tier pricing is not stated on the page.
Performance claims such as 7.6h more focus time per week and 40% more time are vendor-reported marketing figures on the page, not independently verified.
